WITH crm_cust_info AS (
    SELECT  *
    FROM "DataWarehouse"."silver"."crm_cust_info"
)
 ,erp_cust_az12 AS (
    SELECT  *
    FROM "DataWarehouse"."silver"."erp_cust_az12"
)

 ,erp_loc_a101 AS (
    SELECT  *
    FROM "DataWarehouse"."silver"."erp_loc_a101"
)

, dim_data AS (
select
	MD5(cci.cst_id::text) AS customer_key,
	cci.cst_id as customer_id,
	cci.cst_key as customer_number,
	cci.cst_firstname as first_name,
	cci.cst_lastname as last_name,
	cci.cst_marital_status as martial_status,
	case when cci.cst_gndr != 'n/a' then cci.cst_gndr
		else coalesce (eca.gen, 'n/a') end as gender,
	eca.bdate as birthdate,
	ela.cntry as country,
	cci.cst_create_date as create_date
from crm_cust_info as cci
left join erp_cust_az12 as eca
	on cci.cst_key = eca.cid
left join erp_loc_a101 ela
	on cci.cst_key = ela.cid
)

SELECT * FROM dim_data dim

WITH crm_prd_info AS (
    SELECT  *
    FROM "DataWarehouse"."silver"."crm_prd_info"
)
 ,erp_px_cat_g1v2 AS (
    SELECT  *
    FROM "DataWarehouse"."silver"."erp_px_cat_g1v2"
)

, dim_data AS (
select
	MD5(cpi.prd_key::text) AS product_key,
	cpi.prd_id as product_id,
	cpi.prd_key as product_number,
	cpi.prd_nm as product_name,
	cpi.cat_id as category_id,
	epcgv.cat as category,
	epcgv.subcat as subcategory,
	epcgv.maintenance as maintenance,
	cpi.prd_cost as cost,
	cpi.prd_line as product_line,
	cpi.prd_start_dt as start_date
from crm_prd_info as cpi
left join erp_px_cat_g1v2 epcgv
	on cpi.cat_id=epcgv.id
where cpi.prd_end_dt is null
and dbt_valid_to is null
)

SELECT * FROM dim_data dim

WITH crm_sales_details AS (
    SELECT  *
    FROM "DataWarehouse"."silver"."crm_sales_details"
)
 ,dim_products AS (
    SELECT  *
    FROM "DataWarehouse"."gold"."dim_products"
)

 ,dim_customers AS (
    SELECT  *
    FROM "DataWarehouse"."gold"."dim_customers"
)

, fact_data AS (
select
	csd.sls_ord_num as order_number,
	dp.product_key as product_key,
	dc.customer_key as customer_key,
	csd.sls_order_dt as order_date,
	csd.sls_ship_dt as shipping_date,
	csd.sls_due_dt as due_dt,
	csd.sls_sales as sales_amount,
	csd.sls_quantity as quantity,
	csd.sls_price as price
from crm_sales_details as csd
left join dim_products as dp
	on csd.sls_prd_key = dp.product_number
left join dim_customers dc
	on csd.sls_cust_id = dc.customer_id
)

SELECT * FROM fact_data fact
